create_chatsampler_instance: create a ChatSampler instance with a Gemma model and params for multi-turn chat
chat_single_turn: call chat on a ChatSampler to generate a single turn response from a prompt
chat_multi_turn: use ChatSampler with multi_turn enabled to maintain conversation context across multiple turns
chat_streaming: call chat with print_stream enabled to stream model output tokens as they are generated
chat_with_images: call chat with images and start_of_image tokens to generate responses about visual content
